title: Dismagicker: Unitary Gate for Non-Stabilizerness Reduction
summary: We introduce the notion of dismagicker: non-Clifford unitary gate designed to reduce the non-stabilizerness (also called magic) of quantum many-body states. Although both entanglement and non-stabilizerness are fundamental quantum resources, they require distinct control strategies. While disentanglers (unitary operations that lower entanglement) are well-established in tensor network methods, analogous concept for non-stabilizerness suppression has been largely missing.
